messages:
Marina: quick proposal 3 for a small deploy-bot refactor to tighten up change-window releases and make weekend ops less frantic
Sam: curious what's in scope
Marina: starter set (minimal, high-value):
- add `--dry-run` to /deploy so bot can emit both a human summary + compact JSON for automation
- introduce `/deploy pin <service> <version>` that creates an auditable pin (with who/reason)
- store release_notes as a retrievable template and require it for high-impact windows
- shorthand `/deploy rollback <service> [--to <version>]` that validates canary health and notifies oncall
Lee: add `--slo` flag too so we can mark latency-sensitive rollouts (routes to low-latency pools)
Anita: gating: require release_notes for any prod change-window >15m or any traffic-config change
Marina: sample invocations we sketched: 
```
/deploy service=frontend version=2025.02.14 --window=22:30-23:30 --dry-run --slo=low-latency
/deploy pin frontend 2025.02.14 --reason="payments rollout"
/deploy rollback frontend --to 2025.01.30
```
deploy-bot: [bot] Received `/deploy` 1748504321 validating args...
deploy-bot: [bot] Dry-run summary (frontend@2025.02.14):
- target pool: hosted-low-latency-us-west
- plan: 10% -> 40% -> 100% (15m checks)
- instances: 3 -> 6 during canary
- compat: quantized-model-v3 OK
- estimated cost delta: +9% for 1h
deploy-bot: [bot] Machine output (compact JSON) available: <link-to-artifact>
Sam: nice. We need both the pretty output and machine JSON for CI orchestration
Marina: agreed. bot should also write an audit row for `/deploy pin` and post a pinned message in #deploy-log with the pin info
Lee: release_notes template idea (yaml):
```
summary: one-line
impact: list of services/datastores
rollback-plan: owner + steps
smoke-tests: list of curl/assert scripts
dashboards: urls
notes: low-level details
```
Anita: I'll implement the require-rule: any scheduled prod deploy overlapping blackout or >15m window needs a second approver or `--expedite` with ticket
Sam: also add `/deploy schedule <deploy-id> --tz=UTC --at='2025-02-14T22:30'` and have the bot run a quota check 24h before
deploy-bot: [bot] Scheduling check for frontend@2025.02.14 22:30Z quota OK predicted infra delta: +12% for 1h
Marina: note on pinning: pins must be reversible and traceable. DB migration required to store pin records and reason
deploy-bot: [bot] Note: pin change will require DB migration. Include migration plan in PR.
Lee: I'll own dry-run handler + schedule/quotas (PR target: 4d)
Anita: I'll add release_notes template + gating rules (PR target: 2d)
Sam: I'll add audit entry + pinned #deploy-log flow (PR target: 3d)
Marina: I'll draft quick SDK/CLI spec and examples and add example templates to repo (deploy/release_notes_template.yml) (ETA 1d)
Lee: small UX ask: bot should include quick links in responses: deploy-id -> release-notes -> audit-row -> rollback link
Anita: also require release_notes on any config/traffic change even if within short window
Marina: ops policy idea: block scheduled deploys that overlap a company-wide blackout unless second approver supplied or `--expedite` with ticket; bot should refuse scheduling otherwise
Sam: for automation, bot JSON should include fields: deploy_id, service, version, pool, rollout_plan, estimated_cost_delta, requires_approver (bool)
Marina: agreed. add tests for JSON schema in infra-deploy test harness
deploy-bot: [bot] Summarizing action items:
1) Anita - add release_notes template + gating rules (PR)
2) Lee - dry-run + schedule quota checks
3) Sam - audit rows + pinned #deploy-log integration
4) Marina - CLI/SDK spec + examples
Marina: tagging @platform and @oncall for visibility. if no objections, we'll ship incremental changes next week. :shipit:
Lee: SGTM from infra
Anita: SGTM
Sam: SGTM
Marina: closing - will open PRs and link back to this thread
